mission: Frank v0.1 voll lauffähig auf Andreas PC

frontier_selected.workstream: CC-WP-02/CC-WP-03 parser + typed IR causal boundary
frontier_selected.reason: BASE remains NOT_PASS. WP02 V17 has positive Hostinger proxy evidence but formal Andreas target acceptance is open; WP03 has an upstream V7 strict-grammar conflict and a separately demonstrated downstream keyword-identifier typed-IR defect.

fresh_external_knowledge.primary_fallback: lark-parser/lark docs/grammar.md from current upstream GitHub repository
supported_points: Lark terminal priorities are considered before match length/name during lexing.
With contextual/basic lexing, grammar authors must control literal/terminal collisions.
Lark recommends rule-level structure when terminal-regex ambiguity hides alternatives.
Explicit ignored trivia is especially important for LALR predictive behavior.

hypothesis: Removing V17 regex lookahead with a lexical delimiter membrane can preserve the frozen Needle call/relation/qid surface while improving strict collision observability.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Any no-lookahead lexical membrane that reserves or consumes the Needle prefix/trivia will either steal longer qids, create LALR follow conflicts, or reject V17-valid bare-qid/trailing-trivia cases; V17 may already be the simpler robust operating point.

out_of_box_experiment.name: LEXICAL_BOUNDARY_CONSERVATION_SWEEP
out_of_box_experiment.method: Adversarially sweep the Needle.owns/Needle.lowers namespace and trivia boundary across selected V17, whole-prefix V18, and a delimiter-consuming V19 repair while preserving canonical AST comparison and rollback.

examples: Needle.owns.foo: V17 qid accepted; V18 rejects at dot
Needle.ownship: V17 qid; V18 silently parses Needle.owns + hip as prefix relation
Needle.owns2: V17 qid; V18 silently parses relation + numeric RHS
Needle.owns_more: V17 qid; V18 silently parses relation + suffix qid

v19_initial_namespace_sweep.initial_interpretation: Namespace shadow repaired without material bounded latency gain/loss; strict local classification reached missing-interegular gate without an observed LALR GrammarError.

v19_counterevidence_fused.finding: V19 relation tokens consume trailing horizontal trivia after bare Needle.owns and reject V17-valid bare-qid statements before newline/comment/end-of-statement.

out_of_box_experiment.final_experiment_conclusion: The attempted no-lookahead family does not dominate V17. Stop escalating V18/V19/V20 for novelty; preserve V17 and move effort to the known WP03 causal blockers.
out_of_box_experiment.rollback: Production V17 was never changed. A concurrently duplicated V19 grammar/validator/workflow created during the race was deleted after reread; the earlier canonical V19 research artifact remains only as negative evidence.

concurrency_and_dedup.adjudication: One canonical V19 candidate lineage retained; supplemental fuzz is orthogonal evidence only.

upstream.name: V7_STRICT_GRAMMAR_AMBIGUITY
upstream.mechanism: optional RHS in dotted_relation creates a family of LALR follow/shift-reduce conflicts

downstream.name: TYPED_IR_VALUE_BASED_KEYWORD_IDENTIFIER_REJECTION
downstream.mechanism: Grammar aliases reserved words into identifier positions, while current typed IR globally filters keyword token values instead of respecting AST identifier context.

wp03_two_blocker_fusion.causal_order: Repair/replace the V7 strict grammar boundary first, then replay current-main typed IR versus the existing AST-context candidate under identical exact grammar/frontend bytes.

grammar_candidate.strategy: Preserve V7 typed-fn and operator aliases but replace optional dotted_relation with the already-selected V17 Needle relation membrane; preserve compact subtraction and reject bare Needle.lowers.

tests: full current G9 + Dialect strict parsing and determinism
reproduction of current-main keyword-identifier typed-IR bug
reserved-word identifier preservation by existing PR145 candidate
full G9 + Dialect deterministic candidate typed IR

negative_results: Whole-prefix no-lookahead V18 is not namespace-safe and also has strict conflict counterevidence.
Delimiter-consuming V19 fixes prefix shadow but breaks V17-valid bare-qid trailing-trivia/comment semantics.
No evidence supports replacing V17 merely to remove regex lookahead.
The initial WP03 strict red is a grammar failure, but that does not imply typed IR is bug-free; a separate downstream typed-IR defect is real.
next_frontier: Consume the composed Ubuntu/Hostinger WP03 receipt if it materializes; classify execution failure separately from Actions/orchestration failure.

If the V7+V17 membrane is strict/full-source clean, replay PR145 versus current-main typed IR under the exact same grammar/frontend provenance and retain the candidate only if keyword identifiers and all existing typed-IR invariants pass.
If the composed candidate fails, minimize the first strict/full-source/typed-IR counterexample before changing any broader ClayCode semantics.
After WP03 executable closure, replay WP06 hardening under the selected exact grammar/compiler provenance.
Keep formal WP02/BASE promotion open until the registered Andreas Ubuntu developer-system target receipts exist.
